title: JBCクラシックの後に・眩しいの

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The news of Smart Falcon's third straight victory at the JBC Classic monopolizes online trends.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although her popularity continues to grow, she appears to be focusing less on individual impressions and more on the numerical metrics of success.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way home, she runs into one of her first fans, a girl who says she loves how Smart Falcon sparkles. But the Umadol herself can't see her own sparkle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing Smart Falcon shaken, I decide to have a serious talk with her before her next race, the Champions Cup.
